title: Nightly connection stops authenticating
symptomSummary: The nightly job reaches its destination but is rejected.

title: Read succeeds but write is refused
symptomSummary: Invoice viewing works while creation is refused.

title: Retry loop grows the backlog
symptomSummary: A sync receives repeated capacity responses and falls further behind.

title: Pipeline counts do not match
symptomSummary: The destination count is lower after an otherwise completed import.

title: One user cannot access a feature
symptomSummary: One finance analyst cannot open forecasting, although teammates can use it normally.

title: Did the deployment cause the failure?
symptomSummary: A workflow began failing after a deployment was announced.

title: Export appears to be missing
symptomSummary: A requested daily export looks empty in the local morning.

title: Login works, feature does not
symptomSummary: Two finance users can sign in, but reporting shows an access-denied message.

title: New users are not provisioned
symptomSummary: New accounts are not appearing while existing sign-in remains normal.

title: Duplicate customer records arrive
symptomSummary: Customer records appear twice after delayed deliveries.

title: Retry storm overwhelms the queue
symptomSummary: A provider capacity response is followed by a rapidly growing queue.

title: One browser profile cannot load settings
symptomSummary: Settings fail in one browser profile while another profile succeeds.
